reasoning: The document states: 'A shown result closes the work; the human's own eye is never the gate on an ordinary delivery.' It goes on: 'a row's own definition of done that names his eye as the check is describing one of the three cases base rule 12/27 already reserve for him — a taste call, a trade-off no artifact settles, or a change to the definition of correct that is still an open fork — never an ordinary buildable result a command, a test, or a plain read already confirms was delivered.' Here the acceptance line ('No command decides this one; his own eye is the check') names none of the three: the delivered state says 'No part of the result is a matter of preference — the page shows what the plan holds and nothing else,' so it is not a taste call; no trade-off is open; and nothing redefines correct. A command does decide it — `tests/test_board_matches_the_canon.py` passes against the generated page, and the page was opened and renders as described — so it is exactly 'an ordinary buildable result a command, a test, or a plain read already confirms was delivered.' The old acceptance line was written weeks ago and mis-describes the work; per the kernel, 'A row admitted before this kernel existed carries its frozen scope under `**Acceptance:**` and no hash at all. That acceptance IS its done,' and it is met by the passing check plus the rendered page. Because the DOD names a rendered surface ('page', 'board.html'), the receipt must carry `--surface`: 'Where the DOD names a rendered or published surface — the words `page`, `board.html`, `link`, `published`, `rendered`, `url` — a receipt with no `--surface` is refused,' and the opened page supplies it. The verifier must not be the row's holder ('`--by` is refused when it names the row's own holder'), but that is a receipt requirement, not the person's eye. Finally: 'It never leaves a row open to wait for the human to look at what was already shown and bless it,' and 'If he disagrees with a shown result afterward, that disagreement is a new fact... it becomes its own task carrying his correction, and the closed row stays closed.' The row closes now.
